item.title: Urgent gully sewer in council garage leakage near SE18 2TN, Admaston Road, 29th July
item.description:

A pool of foul-smelling wastewater has been sitting over the drain for weeks and is now slowly spreading onto the public street, creating a serious public health hazard. Please dispatch a drainage team to clear the underlying foul water blockage immediately.
